events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and producer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Cleese's Comedy Legacy
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is timeless.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but widely known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered their iconic 'White Album'. A double LP that pushed boundaries and remains a masterpiece.

events.title: 35 years since Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the world lost Freddie Mercury, the iconic lead vocalist of Queen, who died in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled showmanship and voice of Freddie Mercury, 35 years on from his passing. His legacy truly lives forever.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that saw them evolve their sound and songwriting. Still brilliant.

events.title: 46 years since John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles and a global peace activist, tragically passed away in 1980.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years on. His music and message of peace continue to inspire generations worldwide.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering David Bowie, the iconic musician and cultural chameleon, who would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie's Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Forever the Starman. David Bowie would have been 80 today, a true innovator whose influence still shines bright across music and culture.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Elvis Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: The King would have been 92 today! Celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley and the music that changed the world.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and music icon Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Jimmy Page Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! His riffs shaped rock history and continue to inspire.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Sir Rod Stewart, the distinctive voice behind countless hits, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod Stewart Birthday
angles.copy: Raise a glass to Sir Rod Stewart, turning 82 today! Still rocking, still soulful. What's your favourite Rod hit?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham 'Suggs' McPherson, the charismatic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Suggs Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the one and only frontman of Madness! Still bringing the house of fun wherever he goes.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Paul Young, known for his smooth blue-eyed soul vocals, celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Paul Young Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! Still "Wherever I Lay My Hat" his voice is pure gold.

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary country music icon Dolly Parton, who would have celebrated her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Dolly Parton Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: The Queen of Country would have been 81 today. Celebrating the incredible life and music of Dolly Parton, a true superstar.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That lead singer and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Gary Barlow Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! From Take That anthems to his solo success, a true British music legend.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer-songwriter Billy Ocean, known for his string of 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Billy Ocean Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the fantastic Billy Ocean! Get outta our dreams and into our cars, his tunes are still pure joy.

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame's 41st Anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks 41 years since the first induction ceremony for the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame was held in New York City in 1986.

angles.name: Rock Hall Anniversary
angles.copy: Forty-one years ago, rock history was made with the first Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction. Celebrating the legends who started it all!

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen, singer-songwriter, celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Mark Owen Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! Still charming the nation with his unique style and voice.

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert turns 58
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their iconic and final public live concert on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: Rooftop Concert Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles took to the rooftop for their legendary final live performance. An unforgettable moment in music history!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: English singer, drummer, and songwriter Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Phil Collins Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the legendary Phil Collins! From Genesis to his incredible solo career, a true musical powerhouse.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: British actor Hugh Grant, known for his roles in romantic comedies and dramas, celebrates his 67th birthday today.

angles.name: Hugh Grant Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to the charming Hugh Grant! From rom-coms to captivating dramas, a true British screen icon.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: American singer, songwriter, actor, and record producer Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: Justin Timberlake Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From boyband sensation to solo superstar, he truly brings the 'SexyBack'.
